{"id":2034610565,"question_id":3,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781584187,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"12 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2034610565/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters","memory":"12.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int lengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) {\n        int l{};\n        int maxlen{};\n        unordered_map<char , int>mp;\n\n        for(int r = 0 ; r<s.size() ; r++)\n        {\n            mp[s[r]]++;\n\n            while(mp[s[r]] > 1) \n            {\n                mp[s[l]]--;\n                if(mp[s[l]] == 0) mp.erase(s[l]);\n                l++;\n            }\n            maxlen = max(maxlen , r - l + 1);\n        }\n        return maxlen;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-substring-without-repeating-characters","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2144}
